mentions.name: Hypertext argument-mapping tool
mentions.description: This tool uses hypertext to map reasoning and arguments. AI generates a tree of arguments, each given an initial 'debatable' truthfulness rating, and a UI lets a human dig through the tree and mark statements on a 1-5 scale of false/dubious/debatable/plausible/true.
mentions.source_excerpt: I use hypertext to map reasoning and arguments. I have AI skills to map out a tree of arguments, all of which are given an initial "debatable" rating on truthfulness. I have a UI in which a human can dig through the tree and mark statements on a 1-5 scale of false/dubious/debatable/plausible/true.
